Quality continues to be the hallmark of KBL
products, achieved through stringent and
thorough quality controls applied in the
manufacturing process

£1 million
There are many more milestones to be achieved
in the rest of the year. These include adding
to KBL supply chain costs savings tally of £6
million achieved so far through smart sourcing,
increased production and logistics efficiencies,
contributing significantly to KBL financial
bottom line.
